correctness.rationale: All simplicial faces are determined by exact shortest paths in a specified 12-vertex graph. The verified 82-pair radius-two matching is acyclic over all 460 Hasse incidences and has precisely one critical 0-cell and one critical 2-cell; hence Forman yields the integral S^2 homotopy type. Graph case at r1 gives 7 circles and diameter3 implies r3 is a simplex. Verified exhaustive eight-element automorphism group, signed simplicial Lefschetz sums, and character inner products give rational representations; rank-one integral action signs follow from the integer lattice. The full barcode follows from vanishing target groups of inclusion maps.

value.rationale: The graph-metric Rips filtration of a named convex-polyhedral twelve-vertex graph is a natural complete invariant. Its seven cycle classes die at the same threshold at which a rank-one integral sphere class appears, and the D4 orientation character and complete preceding H1 character distinguish its symmetry from that of a bare homotopy sphere. These data are not determined by 3-regularity, diameter or previously published cycle/other-polyhedron examples and provide a rigorous finite benchmark for equivariant persistent topology.
